lines.text: Woe comes to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush, which sends couriers by sea.
The world will see a raised banner and hear a ram's horn, and the LORD will quietly look on.
Before harvest, He cuts off the shoots with a pruning knife and leaves the branches to birds and beasts.
At that time, gifts will be brought from the tall, widely feared nation to Mount Sinai.
